date:ezra-returns-to-jerusalem@de6f0a.note: Seventh year of Artaxerxes, fifth month (7:7-8). The BC year depends on dating Artaxerxes' reign outside Scripture.

date:second-temple-completed@87e7a6.note: Work resumed in Darius's second year (4:24) and finished in his sixth year, Adar 3 (6:15). The BC years depend on dating Darius outside Scripture.

date:second-temple-foundation-laid@87965.note: Gives only relative timing, 'the second year of their coming' (3:8). The BC year depends on dating Cyrus's return outside Scripture.

member-of:ezra_1245>tribe-of-levi@2221ed.note: Ezra descends from Aaron the chief priest (7:5) and is called the priest (7:11). Levitical descent is not stated in this text.

member-of:joshua_893>tribe-of-levi@38957.note: Called a priest, son of Jozadak (3:2). The text never says Levite; Levitical priesthood is an inference from the Aaronic line.

occurred-at:second-temple-completed>jeru.note: 5:2 has them build 'the house of God which is at Jerusalem'; 6:15 says this house was finished.

occurred-at:second-temple-foundation-lai.note: 3:8 has the work begin on the house of God at Jerusalem; 3:10 says the builders laid its foundation.

participated-in:artaxerxes_314>ezra-retu.note: Artaxerxes granted Ezra all his request (7:6) and decreed that Israelites may go up with him (7:13).

participated-in:ezra_1245>ezra-returns-t.note: Ezra went up from Babylon (7:6) and had prepared his heart to teach the law (7:10). Script verse 7:1 is only his genealogy.

participated-in:haggai_1349>second-templ.note: Haggai prophesied to the Jews (5:1); the building prospered through his prophesying (6:14). He did not build, so this is an interpretation.

participated-in:joshua_893>cyrus-decree-.note: 2:2 lists Jeshua among those who came with Zerubbabel; 3:2 identifies that Jeshua as the priest son of Jozadak. Identity is by context.

participated-in:zechariah_3016>second-te.note: Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied (5:1); the building prospered through his prophesying (6:14). He did not build, so this is an interpretation.

participated-in:zerubbabel_3054>cyrus-de.note: 'Which came with Zerubbabel' (2:2) places him in the first return. Script verse 1:8 does not name him.

parent-of:josedech_815>joshua_893@e86869.note: 3:2 gives the father as Jozadak, not Josedech. Josedech is that name in another spelling, so the link rests on the spelling.

parent-of:seraiah_2494>ezra_1245@a799ee.note: 'Ezra the son of Seraiah' (7:1). The 7:1-5 genealogy skips generations compared with 1 Chronicles 6, so Seraiah may be a remote ancestor.
